body: A young woman with the same unchanged face and soft natural complexion, captured in a spontaneous 90s film snapshot. Her loose black hair falls over the shoulders of a baby-blue cropped zip-up sweatshirt worn over a white ribbed tank top. She looks directly into the camera with a relaxed expression and a faint smile. The dim beige wall behind her is covered with colorful polaroids, tiny stickers, music flyers, and handwritten messages. Bright on-camera flash, slightly cool color temperature, natural skin texture, subtle motion blur, authentic disposable-camera grain, imperfect vintage composition, nostalgic bedroom photography.
